courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鉛心橡膠支承隔震
related.transfer: 可遷移「週期延長與隔震改造的動機」與「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鉛心橡膠支承隔震的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building" and "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷；鉛心橡膠支承隔震則以以鉛心屈服強度、橡膠側向勁度與等效阻尼，拉長橋梁週期並把位移集中在可檢查的支承為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on period lengthening, load-transfer members, staged jacking and property bounds that protect historic buildings from earthquake damage; Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation centres on lead-core yield strength, rubber lateral stiffness and equivalent damping that lengthen the bridge period and concentrate displacement in inspectable bearings, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「隔震層週期」與「隔震週期 T_eff」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鉛心橡膠支承隔震，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗與量產試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Isolated period” and “Isolated period T_eff”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Prototype and production testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證則以以力—速度本構、原型與逐件試驗、安裝置中與系統識別，證明每具黏滯阻尼器提供設計阻尼為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on period lengthening, load-transfer members, staged jacking and property bounds that protect historic buildings from earthquake damage; Viscous-damper performance verification centres on force–velocity laws, prototype and production tests, installation centring and system identification that prove every viscous damper delivers its design damping, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「隔震層週期」與「附加阻尼比」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到黏滯阻尼器性能驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Isolated period” and “Supplemental damping ratio”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Viscous-damper performance verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 既有建築基礎隔震改造
history.text: Forell/Elsesser 在 1980 年代初期開始把基礎隔震用於建築，鹽湖城市郡大樓在多年整修後於 1989 年重新開放，被該公司稱為全球第一個以基礎隔震改造的既有建築。同年 Loma Prieta 地震損壞舊金山市政府，其後的改造切斷約 530 根柱與約 1,500 ft 磚牆以安裝隔震器，成為當時最大的隔震結構；奧克蘭市政府的隔震改造則是當時最高的隔震建築。猶他州議會大廈後來以 256 個隔震器與後拉預力托換梁完成改造，2020 年規模 5.7 地震也驗證了鹽湖城市郡大樓的隔震效益。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Forell/Elsesser began applying base isolation to buildings in the early 1980s, and the Salt Lake City and County Building, reopened in 1989 after a multi-year renovation, is described by the firm as the world's first base-isolation retrofit of an existing building. In the same year the Loma Prieta earthquake damaged San Francisco City Hall, whose subsequent retrofit cut about 530 columns and about 1,500 ft of brick walls to install isolators and became the largest isolated structure of its time, while the Oakland City Hall isolation retrofit was then the tallest. The Utah State Capitol was later retrofitted with 256 isolators and post-tensioned transfer girders, and a magnitude 5.7 earthquake in 2020 confirmed the benefit of isolation at the Salt Lake City and County Building. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
